title: Professional Agentic Architect
description: Google Cloud's certification for technical practitioners who design and manage autonomous, AI-driven agentic workflows, weighing reliability, performance, cost, security and scalability. About 80 multiple-choice questions in 3 hours, then hands-on labs in Google Skills for those who pass.
notice: Unfinished: Read Aloud covers four courses, three of the learning path's ten plus the related Build Your First Agent with ADK course. Google publishes the other seven in a player format Read Aloud cannot read, or not at all. The exam has 34 voice scenes and 41 written practice questions, fewer than the real exam asks.
